description: Registry (not a catalog) of legacy GeneXus 8/9 export elements (ExportFile with <GXObject><Elemento> identified by element NAME, no type GUID). Representation/governance layer: classifies each legacy element as 'equivalent' (has a real modern type in the catalog) or 'orphan' (no modern equivalent, materialized in its own folder with typeToken gxlegacy/<Elemento>). The export/materialization engine is separate and confirms exact tag/casing when parsing real GX9. Doc owner: 01k-legacy-element-registry.md.
